# Hero Image Spec — Arataki (Automotive)

**Purpose:** Static visual for V3 (proof-led) cold email + LinkedIn share card aimed at licensed motor vehicle traders (MVT). Recipient sees a CGA disclosure bundle that looks like it would stand up in front of the Motor Vehicle Disputes Tribunal.

**Generated by:** Kate (Vessel Studio) OR delegated to a designer
**Saved to:** `/public/assets/hero/arataki-evidence.png` in the repo, then deployed
**Final URL:** `https://www.assembl.co.nz/assets/hero/arataki-evidence.png`

---

## Composition

- **Aspect ratio:** 16:9 (1600 × 900 px, retina 3200 × 1800 px)
- **Subject:** Flat-design rendering of an open used-vehicle sale disclosure pack on warm cream paper. Two pages — left page cover, right page disclosure section.
- **Background:** Warm paper `#FAF7F2`.
- **Pack rendering:** Flat illustration. Brand-canon typography + palette only.
- **Vessel cameo:** Top-right corner — Evidence Vessel motif at 15% of canvas height.

---

## Page content (visible in the mock-pack)

**Left page (cover):**
- Top eyebrow: `assembl · evidence pack` (IBM Plex Mono uppercase, taupe)
- H1: `Used-Vehicle Sale Compliance Bundle` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 400, pounamu)
- Sub-line: `2014 Honda Fit · MFK231 · 89,420 km · Sale price NZ$12,800`
- Date: `25 March 2026`
- Decision pill: `✅ APPROVED for sale + buyer handover` (pounamu fill, cream text)

**Right page (disclosure section — the punchline):**
- H2: `Pre-sale disclosure` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- Workshop work entry: `Brake-pad replacement · 18 Mar 2026 · workshop`
- Workshop work entry: `Full service · 22 Mar 2026 · workshop`
- Flagged disclosure (highlighted): `Service light noticed during pre-sale prep · diagnosed, cleared, not a defect · disclosed in writing to buyer`
- PPSR check: `✓ clean · no security interests · checked 25 Mar 2026`
- WoF reference: `Issued 14 Mar 2026 · valid 12 months · NZTA historic odo ascending`
- Footer: `Buyer + dealer copies sealed · MVDT-ready`

The "service light disclosure" entry is the visual STORY. assembl drafts the disclosure language for things you'd otherwise forget or downplay — so the operator stays well in front of CGA risk.

---

## Text overlay (embedded in image)

- **Top-left:** small Cormorant italic caption: `Arataki · 2014 Honda Fit MFK231 · approved by Rangi Tāne, Sales Manager · 25 March 2026`
- **Bottom-centre:** H1 statement: `Mahi that earns its proof.` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- **No CTA in the image itself.**

## Vessel Studio prompt

```
A flat-design editorial composition. 16:9 aspect ratio. Warm cream
paper background (#FAF7F2). Subject: an open two-page PDF document at
slight perspective — left page is a used-vehicle sale compliance
bundle cover for a 2014 Honda Fit, right page shows a pre-sale
disclosure list with workshop work, PPSR clean status, and one
highlighted "disclosed in writing to buyer" item. Cream ceramic
Evidence Vessel motif top-right corner. Cormorant Garamond headings,
IBM Plex Mono small labels, Inter body. No photography of cars or
workshops, no AI shimmer. Style: Aesop catalogue meets editorial
design. Subtle drop-shadows under document pages. The phrase "Mahi
that earns its proof." sits in Cormorant weight 300 at the bottom
centre.
```

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Aspect 16:9 (1600×900 minimum, retina preferred)
- [ ] Cream `#FAF7F2` background dominant ≥80%
- [ ] Pounamu `#2B6B57` only on document accents
- [ ] The highlighted "disclosed in writing" entry visually distinct (so MVT recipients clock it as the differentiator)
- [ ] PPSR + WoF references readable at LinkedIn thumbnail size
- [ ] No car photography (it's about compliance proof, not vehicle imagery)
- [ ] No AI shimmer / no glow effects
- [ ] Lowercase `assembl` if wordmark visible

---

**Time to generate (Vessel Studio + 1-2 retakes): ~5 minutes of Kate's time.**
